headline: Markets closed for weekend; on last session, Sensex fell 289 points amid inflation concerns.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Indian stock markets are closed today, 14 November 2026, on account of the weekend.
On the last trading day, Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns weighed on broader sentiment.
Stronger US dollar and demand concerns impacted global base metals momentum.
Earlier in the week, lower crude oil prices and foreign fund inflows helped drive market gains.
whatHappening: NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their weekly rally for the third consecutive week.
PSU Banks emerged as top sectoral gainers during the weekly wrap-up.
USFDA concluded an inspection at Zydus' UK-based LiqMeds unit with 4 observations.
Noel Tata indicated engagement with regulators regarding Tata Sons' potential listing.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 16 November 2026. In the last trading session, indices slipped due to fresh inflation concerns, with Sensex shedding 289 points. Despite late-week pressure, benchmark indices Nifty50 and Sensex closed the week higher, marking three straight weeks of gains.
